name: Ullmer's Dairy Equipment & Fabrication
old_description: Whether you’re looking to buy or sell dairy equipment, need a refurbish, or require custom fabrication, Ullmer’s Dairy Equipment & Fabrication is your trusted partner. Our dedication to quality and personalized service makes us the premier choice for all your dairy equipment needs.
about:
Ullmer's Dairy Equipment & Fabrication operates from Pulaski, Wisconsin. The company was founded in 1991 by Francis Ullmer, who began by selling a single bulk tank from his front yard. The business grew into a 10-acre inventory of used cheese-making equipment in Northeast Wisconsin. In 2013, after 22 years, Francis passed ownership to his son Paul, continuing the family-owned operation.

Today the company runs a well-equipped production shop with an in-house engineering team and skilled fabricators. They specialize in custom fabrication of food-grade stainless steel equipment, including batch pasteurizers, butter churns, cheese cutters, presses, vats, CIP systems, combo vats, conveyors, COP tanks, curd mills, curd unloaders, drain tables, hoop washers, and stainless steel tanks. The shop also refurbishes used dairy equipment and buys, sells, and trades inventory. No headcount or facility square footage is disclosed.

Ullmer's serves the cheese, dairy, food, beverage, and other sanitary industries. Their customer base includes cheese makers, wineries, breweries, maple syrup producers, honey makers, and educational institutions. They provide both custom-built equipment and refurbished units for these sectors.

The company emphasizes honesty, integrity, and exceptional customer satisfaction, aiming to exceed expectations with precision and care. Their stated differentiators include competitive pricing, dependable experienced staff, and a commitment to versatility—captured in their motto that there's nothing they can't do when they set their minds to it.
